# Content engine (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`content-editing`](../../flows/content-editing/FLOW.md), [`content-modeling`](../../flows/content-modeling/FLOW.md), [`schema-builder`](../../flows/schema-builder/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Turns the content type definitions (JSON) into database tables in the `content` schema and stores document trees (root rows plus nested component tables): definition validation (also of one candidate against the registered types, `validateCandidateDefinition`), migration generation and running (`content:generate`, `content:migrate`), the content type registry, the content repository and the field-type rules (value parsing, media columns, richtext sanitizing). Format: `docs/modules/content-schema.md`.

## Techniques

Definitions (the required type `displayName`, optional field `displayName` and `width`, and the `component` value that names each component table) validated by zod + `DefinitionValidator.rules`; SQL planned from a definition snapshot (`SqlGenerator.rules`, `Naming.rules`) and written as checked migration files; destructive changes refused. A component table whose `component` value changed (same content type and `apiPath`) is renamed with its data, constraints and indexes (`pairRenamedTables`), not dropped; renames are listed as `-- Renamed <old> -> <new>` lines and are not destructive. Kysely for content rows with its own transaction runner and after-commit callbacks. Each field type is one `FieldTypeSpec` in `FIELD_TYPE_SPECS`. Richtext is always sanitized (`sanitize-html`) before it is stored.

## Technologies

NestJS 11, Kysely 0.28, PostgreSQL 17, zod, sanitize-html, Node.js `crypto`.

## Entry points

`pnpm content:generate` (`--check` in CI, `--dry-run`), `pnpm content:migrate` (part of `deploy:migrate`); `ContentRegistry`, `ContentRepository`, `ContentDbProvider` and the field-type exports in `index.ts` for documents, graphql and media.

## Where to change what

A new field type: one spec in `domain/field-types/FieldTypeRegistry.rules.ts` (and its constant in `ContentEngine.constants.ts`); the documents and graphql modules pick it up. A new content type: a definition file plus `content:generate`. The migration CLIs are a tier 3 area.
